description: Healthcare is fundamental to Ohioans’ quality of life and our children’s success. With over 25% of Ohio and 2 in 5 Ohio children covered by Medicaid, the General Assembly has a tremendous opportunity to invest in the wellness of Ohioans. Too often our General Assembly puts up obstacles to coverage.
